AcceptedInvite.description: The profile an accepted invite joined.

AcceptInvite.description: The token from an invite link.

Account.description: An account of a household, in one currency.

AccountType.description: What kind of account it is. No individual holdings are tracked, only the account's value.

AccountValue.description: An account's balance on a date, in the account's currency.

CreatedInvite.description: A new invite; string CreatedInvite.Token goes in the link and is never stored or shown again.

CurrencyInfo.description: A currency the app knows, as seeded from ISO 4217.

ForecastPoint.description: One month of the forecast: the total with a low, an expected and a high return.

ForecastResult.description: The forecast in one currency, at today's exchange rates (a forecast does not guess future rates).

InviteMember.description: Whom to invite: the email address of their Google account.

LoanCalculationRequest.description:
A variable-rate annuity loan to calculate, nothing stored. Amounts are in string LoanCalculationRequest.Currency,
which has int LoanCalculationRequest.MinorUnits decimals (the web app has both from GET /api/currencies).

LoanCalculationResult.description: The schedule without and with the extra payments, and what the extras save.

LoanExtrasView.description: A loan's extra payments and recorded balances, amounts in the loan's currency.

LoanView.description: A stored loan as the API shows it: rates in percent, like the calculator.

MonthlyExtraInput.description: An extra repayment with every payment from a date, optionally until a date.

amount.description: The balance owed in the loan's own currency.

balanceDate.description: The day of that balance: the latest on or before the date asked for.

converted.description: The balance in the target currency, rounded to its minor units; null when a rate is missing.

rateDate.description: The date of the exchange rate used; null when no conversion was needed or possible.

securedOnProperty.description: Left out of liquid net worth, like the property it is secured on.

NetWorthDebt.description: One loan's part of the net worth on a date: a debt at its latest recorded balance, shown as a positive amount owed.

amount.description: The balance in the account's own currency.

balanceDate.description: The day of that balance: the latest on or before the date asked for.

converted.description: The balance in the target currency, rounded to its minor units; null when a rate is missing.

rateDate.description: The date of the oldest exchange rate used; null when no conversion was needed or possible.

NetWorthLine.description: One account's part of the net worth on a date.

NetWorthPoint.description: Net worth at the end of a month (or today), for the history.

total.description: The converted account lines minus the converted debts.

liquid.description: The liquid lines minus the debts not secured on property: property and pensions are left out.

loansWithoutBalance.description: Loans paid out by the date with no recorded balance yet. They are not counted, so the totals are too high by what they owe.

NetWorthResult.description:
Net worth on a date in one currency. Without a rate for some account's currency that account can't be
converted: it is left out of the totals and its currency listed in IReadOnlyList<string> NetWorthResult.MissingRates, so the
totals are incomplete and the UI must say so. A missing rate is never treated as 1.0.

PendingInvite.description: An invite that hasn't been accepted yet.

ProfileRole.description: What a user may do in a profile. Owners also manage the profile and its members.

ProfileSummary.description: A profile as one of its members sees it.

RateChangeInput.description: A rate change: the nominal annual rate in percent (5.24 is 5.24 %) from a date.

SaveAssumption.description: What the household expects of an account; the return is in percent per year, like the loan rates.

SaveSnapshot.description: Balances of several accounts on one date.

ScheduleRow.description: One payment; every amount is in the result's currency.

ScheduleSummary.description: When a schedule ends and what it costs.

SignedIn.description: The signed-in user and the profiles they belong to.

SignInConfig.description: What the web app needs to show the Google sign-in button.

SnapshotSaved.description: A saved snapshot: its date and how many balances it holds.

SnapshotValue.description: One account's balance in a snapshot, in the account's own currency.

UpdateAccount.description: Changes to an account; a missing field stays as it is. Archived true archives it, false restores it.

UpdateProfile.description: New settings for a profile; a null one stays as it is.

User.description: A person who has signed in, as the app knows them.
